scripts.build:snapshot: cd .. && uv run cp snapshot && cd frontend && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode snapshot
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run build:snapshot && npm run build:demo && if command -v caffeinate >/dev/null; then caffeinate -dimsu playwright test; else playwright test; fi
scripts.build:demo: cd .. && uv run cp snapshot --out frontend/.demo-data && uv run python scripts/build_demo_bundle.py && cd frontend && node scripts/vendor_pyodide.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode demo
